trainer.dialogueBefore: PI Carlos: I'm a private investigator. And you, unless I'm much mistaken, are a trainer!
trainer.dialogueAfter: PI Carlos: My conclusion: I've lost. Case closed.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Collector Douglas: Three of Eevee's evolutions, and every one of them mine! Feast your eyes!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Collector Douglas: I'll just have to collect the rest of them. Then you'll see!

trainer.dialogueBefore: Collector Brady: I've gathered rare Pokémon from every corner of Sinnoh. Six of them! Want to see?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Collector Brady: Collecting them is one thing. Training them is another thing entirely.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ruin Maniac Bryan: The rocks round here hide all sorts of old secrets. Don't you go digging before I do!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ruin Maniac Bryan: Old stones I understand. Battles, not so much.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ruin Maniac Ronald: My Shieldon was brought back from a fossil. A living piece of history!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ruin Maniac Ronald: Have a rest, Shieldon. You've waited this long, after all.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Collector Jamal: Porygon was made by people, not born. That makes it the rarest of the rare!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Collector Jamal: Even the rarest Pokémon loses sometimes, it turns out.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Beauty Devon: Three Wormadam in three different cloaks. Fashion is a battle too, you know!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Beauty Devon: Out-dressed and out-battled. What a day.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Psychic Mitchell: I knew you were coming before you'd even left Veilstone City.
trainer.dialogueAfter: Psychic Mitchell: That, though... that I didn't see coming.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Psychic Abigail: My mind and my Pokémon's minds are one. Can you keep up with all of us?
trainer.dialogueAfter: Psychic Abigail: Your thoughts moved too fast for us to read.
